paper_title: Encoding Two-Dimensional Range Top-k Queries Revisited
statement: In this paper, we proposed encodings for answering Top-k queries on 2D arrays. For 2 × n arrays, we proposed upper and lower bounds on space for answering 3-sided sorted and unsorted Top-k queries. Finally, we obtained an (m lg (k+1)n  n + 2nm(m − 1) + o(n))-bit encoding for answering 4-sided sorted Top-k queries on m × n arrays. We end with the following open problems: (a) can we support 4-sided sorted Top-k queries with efficient query time on m × n arrays using less than O(nm lg n) bits when m = o(lg n)? (b) is there any improved lower or upper bound for answering 4-sided sorted Top-k queries on 2 × n arrays?
